stem_book: Find the value of p, q, r, … which represent real numbers. (i) If the GM and AM between two numbers are in the ratio n : m, then the ratio between the two numbers is [m + p√(m^(q) − n²)] / [m + r√(m^(q) − n²)]. (ii) An arithmetic progression is given, a, b, c, in which G.M. of a & c is 4 and H.M. of a & c is 16/5 and the common difference of the progression is 3; the values of a, b, c are p, q, r respectively. (iii) It is given that four times the geometric mean of two numbers 'a' and 'b' is equal to the arithmetic mean, such that a > b > 0, then value of (a + b)/(a − b) is p√(q²/(5r)).
derived: (i) p = 1, q = 2, r = −1 (ii) p = 2, q = 5, r = 8 (iii) 4/√15 (p = 1, q = 4, r = 3 one of several fits)
